title: ProActive IT
subtitle: Essential managed IT with the DE Security Foundation included, for smaller, less complex environments that need professional technology ownership without a large internal IT burden.
intro: ProActive IT is the starting point of the ProActive Ecosystem. It replaces reactive break-fix support with one accountable partner for users, devices, access and support, and establishes a documented, security-first baseline before the business expands into deeper workplace, backup, security operations and compliance programs.

facts.label: Best fit
facts.value: Smaller, less complex environments that need essential protection and a documented baseline.

facts.label: Primary outcome
facts.value: A managed baseline for users, devices, support and security hygiene.

facts.label: Published starting point
facts.value: From $125 per user per month, with a $1,600 monthly minimum.

purpose: Replace purely reactive IT support with a stable managed model.
Establish ownership of users, endpoints, access, patching and support flow.
Give leadership one accountable partner for day-to-day IT direction and risk reduction.

included.detail: Triage and coordination for covered users.
Endpoint, identity, email and security monitoring baseline.
Awareness and phishing resilience for users.
Users, devices and access recorded as the operating baseline.
A clear route into ProActive Office as needs grow.

notIncluded.detail: No default backup program at this level. Endpoint backup begins in ProActive Office.
Begins in ProActive Office; available to ProActive IT clients only as a separately scoped addition.
Audit-grade documentation is handled in higher tiers or standalone engagements.

ladder.name: Office
ladder.focus: Managed daily workplace, endpoint backup, 24/7 MDR

ladder.name: Business
ladder.focus: Backup and DR posture, compliance and risk reporting

moveUp.when: Onboarding, productivity platforms, managed network, endpoint backup and 24/7 detection and response become important.
The organization needs backup and disaster recovery posture, compliance and risk reporting, and semi-annual planning reviews.
Multiple sites, regulated data, advanced compliance reporting or quarterly executive reviews are required.

deliverables: Recommended roadmap for add-ons and tier movement

engagement.detail: Finds risk, gaps and current conditions.
One of four ProActive models, with scope.

cta.label: Schedule a Cyber Risk Assessment
cta.detail: Confirm the right service level, required controls and implementation roadmap for your environment.

scopeNote: Published rates are starting points, not quotes. Final pricing depends on users, endpoints, locations, infrastructure, backup requirements and security and compliance scope; your Cyber Risk Assessment confirms final scope. This datasheet names no customers and makes no vendor-specific claims.
